description.narrative: The World Bank provides significant financial and technical support for developing countries in their efforts to eradicate poverty and achieve the SDGs. Ireland provides direct contributions to the World Bank through the Department of Finance. Irish Aid supplements this with support for a number of programmes, supporting the poorest countries and those in fragile situations in their efforts to develop the private sector with Africa Fragility Initiative, an IFC programme. This budget line also covers funding for UNCTAD's Debt Management and Financial Analysis System (DMFAS) Programme . In line with A Better World's priorities of gender equality, Irish Aid supports two Trust Funds - IFC's Gender Partnership that aims to advance women’s economic empowerment and inclusion; and IBRD Umbrella Facility for Gender Equality (UFGE) programme. Ireland joined the IBRD and IDA - Food systems 2030 Multi-Donor Trust Fund in 2022. Food Systems 2030 programme aim is to contribute to the creation of foundations for sustainable food systems that deliver improved livelihoods and safe, affordable and nutritious diets for all.
